topic: recalc job execution issues and troubleshooting
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on the difficulties encountered when running a recalculation (recalc) job. One participant questioned whether restarting the process was necessary due to available inventory, as the previous run had failed or stalled. The participants discussed technical issues with the Rundeck platform, noting that the system repeatedly prompts for parameter selection even after multiple attempts to restart the job. Someone confirmed they had cleaned up steps 2 and 3 and restarted the process.
